security.safetyZoneDescription: Keep your account protected by regularly reviewing your security settings.

intro.consequence1: Your account will be permanently closed. Once completed, this process cannot be undone.
intro.consequence2: Your personal data will be deleted according to our privacy policy. Some records may be preserved when required by legal or security obligations.
intro.consequence3: Deleting your account is a serious action. We recommend reviewing your information before continuing.
intro.subscriptionTitle: Deleting your account does not cancel your subscription
intro.subscriptionBody: If you have an active subscription through the App Store or Google Play, it will continue until you cancel it directly in the store's settings.

reauth.title: Confirm your identity
reauth.description: For your security, confirm your identity before continuing to delete your account.

confirm.title: Final confirmation
confirm.bullet2: Data marked for deletion by our policy will be removed.
confirm.bullet3: Some records may be retained according to our retention policy.
confirm.bullet4: Your subscription will not be cancelled automatically.

submitting.description: We're protecting your data and completing your request. This may take a few moments.

errors.USER_CANCELLED: Confirmation was cancelled. Nothing was changed.

errors.NETWORK_ERROR: Could not connect. Check your internet connection and try again.

errors.reauthCancelled: Confirmation was cancelled. Nothing was changed.

errors.reconciliationRequired: Your account already has a deletion request on file. Our team will review it.
errors.requestFailed: We could not process your request right now. Please try again.
